'''Akero''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]], and the second-in-command of Mandalorian leader [[Vipsanis]]. He was a young, capable fighter who was in search of fame. As the planet [[Endelaan]] was attacked, Akero got his commander in charge of the troops ordered to occupy the planet. While he fulfilled the task, he respected the defenders of the planet unlike Vipsanis.<ref name="The Unknown Regions" />
